overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Council's attorney-client redactions of 2016 executive session minutes were not a withholding under the OML, and redacted discussions need not be summarized.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Council improperly redacted August and October 2016 executive session minutes by asserting attorney-client privilege.
allegations.key_passage: Because the executive session minutes are no longer being withheld from the public under the Open Meeting Law, we find no violation of that law and we have no reason to challenge the Board's claim of attorney-client privilege.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the released executive session minutes failed to include a summary of the discussions that were redacted.
allegations.key_passage: there is no requirement that the minutes include a summary of the discussions that were redacted

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
